Messages.Author: Smiling Tom, The Anarch
Messages.Body:
Ok, this is simple.
My prey plays a Galaric' Legacy
I cancel Galaric' Legacy tapping the bleeding the vine, thus my prey
recieves an additional MPA

The question is, can my prey play *another* trifle?

The same question would sum up if my prey had already 2 MPA (via anson,
parthenon, etc) and as his first MPA plays a Trifle. If I cancel his Trifle,
can he play another trifle as his second MPA?

Thanks in advance

Smiling Tom, The Anarch

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Smiling Tom, The Anarch wrote:
> Ok, this is simple.
> My prey plays a Galaric' Legacy
> I cancel Galaric' Legacy tapping the bleeding the vine, thus my prey
> recieves an additional MPA
>
> The question is, can my prey play *another* trifle?

No. A card canceled "as it is played" is still played.

> The same question would sum up if my prey had already 2 MPA (via anson,
> parthenon, etc) and as his first MPA plays a Trifle. If I cancel his Trifle,
> can he play another trifle as his second MPA?

No.

nope. A methuselah can play only one trifle each turn.

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:



From the online rulebook:
"Some master cards are identified as trifles. When a Methuselah plays a
trifle *(and it isn't canceled), she gains an additional master phase action.
A Methuselah can only play one trifle each turn."

*emphasis mine.

If you cancel the trifle, you don't get the additional MPA.
